description: Render a JTD to PNG with the app's REAL engine (full fidelity; only needed to check skins and effects). Requires a checkout of the repo AND a running dev server. For everything else use diagram_svg, which needs neither.

out.description: Output path: .png (default, full fidelity) or .svg for a vector image (no skins, images or icon glyphs). Default: a temp PNG

name: diagram_render
